text:
Evan: Quick bench ask — can someone run a lightweight onboarding smoke + hotpath latency sweep for sablex-7b? Need p50/p95/p99 for seq_len 512 and 2048, and comparison with KV cache on/off. Target infra: 8x A100 (75GB). Batch sizes: 1, 4, 16. Prefer q4f16 quant profile. Please collect GPU/util, host stalls, and nvprof flame for any p99 spikes. Post raw logs + a short summary here.

Priya: I can pick this up after stand. Planning smoke + full hotpath for 2k tail. ETA ~4h. Any canonical prompt sets to use?

Evan: use the lightweight prompt set at /bench/prompt-sets/lightweight.json and add ~10 chat-like prompts (short + multi-turn). Also record token counts and approximate token cost. Link baseline here: https://redwood.internal/baselines/sablex7b

Priya: Got it. Will run with/without kvcache and push logs to gs://redwood-bench/sablex7b/1719500000/raw.log and summary to gs://redwood-bench/sablex7b/1719500000/summary.md

Jamal: Infra check — we need nvprof and a warmup marker. @perf-bot can you spin the 8xA100 rig in ci-ops-2 and enable nvprof sampling for bench job?

perf-bot: Deploy queued. Job id: bench-1719500000-sbx. Expected ready in ~12m :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Lucy: Quick Q — do we need both 512 and full 2048 runs? 2k is expensive. Could do 512 plus one targeted 2048 longform to estimate tail.

Evan: Yes — priority is tail for long sequences. Do 512 for distribution and one 2048 sweep to capture p95/p99.

Priya: Starting runs. Config I'm using:
```
model: sablex-7b
precision: q4f16
seq_len: [512, 2048]
batches: [1, 4, 16]
kvcache: [on, off]
warmup_steps: 10
samples_per_config: 30
```

Priya: First pass complete — quick highlights: 
- seq512 batch=1 kvcache=on: p50 28ms, p95 120ms, p99 210ms
- seq2048 batch=1 kvcache=on: p50 120ms, p95 520ms, p99 900ms
- kvcache=off increases p99 by ~30-40% on 2k runs
Raw logs: gs://redwood-bench/sablex7b/1719500000/raw.log

Evan: Nice. Can you attach allocation snapshot, GPU utilization, and nvprof flame for the 2k p99 run? Also capture host-side stall markers.

Priya: Uploaded GPU snapshot: util ~92%, mem 54GB used. Noted host-side stalls around token ~1200. Flame for 2k p99: gs://redwood-bench/sablex7b/1719500000/flame_2k_p99.svg

Jamal: Host-side stalls + token index suggests prefetching interactions with batching. I'll grab the profiler output. Quick triage idea: reduce prefetch window and test async kvcache fetch path.

Lucy: If we can test a small runtime tweak to prefetch=64 tokens, we might see reduced CPU stalls. Want me to open a tiny experiment PR?

Jamal: Yes please — open a draft PR referencing bench-1719500000 and I'll run a canary on the rig.

Lucy: Draft PR created: #5123 (prefetch=64 experiment). Marked draft.

Evan: Decision criteria: if prefetch tweak reduces 2k p99 by >15% without hurting 512 distribution, we accept as a temporary hotspot fix. Priya, can you re-run only the 2048 batch=1 kvcache=on case with prefetch=64?

Priya: Re-run queued (only the single 2k config). ETA ~25m.

perf-bot: bench-1719500000-sbx: re-run with prefetch=64 started.

Priya: Re-run results:
- seq2048 batch=1 kvcache=on prefetch=256 (baseline): p99 900ms
- seq2048 batch=1 kvcache=on prefetch=64: p99 720ms -> ~20% improvement
CPU host stalls reduced ~40% on sampled traces. Flame and logs updated.

Evan: Excellent. Jamal — can you assess risk and prep a patch/backport for q4f16 runtime? Also include an opt-in runtime flag for dedicated pools.

Jamal: Will draft PR and include performance regression tests for short sequences. Risk notes: possible small regressions for short-latency workloads due to reduced prefetch. We'll gate behind a config flag and roll out to a subset of pools first.

Priya: Final summary and artifacts uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/sablex7b/1719500000/summary.md (includes p50/p95/p99 tables, GPU util, host stall analysis, and flame links).

Lucy: Adding summary to the onboarding checklist and pinging product for release notes.

Evan: Thanks all — great async work. I'll close the loop once Jamal's backport PR is merged and we verify canary. :tada:
